_note: Деталь 4 — PEEK Radome v2c (02_01 §5.2 + 01_04 §5.5). Hollow PEEK dome Ø25 (= Zone-3 flange) frozen. Wall 1.5-2.0 (RF vs strength). Cavity for PCB stack. NB cavity height is NOT antenna<->Ti clearance (that is cavityH - lockGrooveZ - t/2 = 8.0 at the bayonet datum) and the >=12 floor is OURS, not canon's (02_01 5.3 asks >=8) - 00_07 HW.33. Internal axial headroom is cavityH + inner cap radius, not cavityH. Shield bell >=3mm rise / R>=5 (anti-overgrowth, no callus edge). Bayonet socket = L-slot mating Деталь-3 lugs, cut in the OUTER band of a local internal RIM BOSS whose INNER band is the seal land; the rim is FLAT and the single O-ring groove is the flange's (00_07 HW.33 branch (а), applied 2026-09-14). The rim cavity under the boss, <=Ø15.57 at the 80 % gland fill, is the CEILING handed to the board layout HW.9 as an input (every term a minimum). Cathode O2 = side/perimeter (02_02 §1.2), NOT sealed under the dome.
name: radome

notes.material: PEEK (polyetheretherketone), medical grade - chosen for RF, not for strength: er 3.2 and tan d 0.003 at 868 MHz make it effectively transparent to the antenna, where water (er about 80) is the thing that is not (02_01 5.2). Canon names UV-stable PC/ASA coloured to bark as a declared alternative. Not a bio-contact part - but NOT mechanically idle either: 02_01 5.2 calls it an anti-vandal sealed cover, and 00_07 HW.33 makes its RIM a hard datum that lands on the flange top face and closes the single O-ring groove there, so treat the rim as a load-bearing sealing face
notes.process: Thermal moulding (термолиття) is the route costed in 02_06 1.2 at the 1K tier; the rim, however, is a machined DATUM face: under branch (а) of 00_07 HW.33 the seal squeeze is set by the flange groove depth alone, and the FLATNESS of this rim is one of the two mating faces the +/-98 um O-ring chain must also cover (script 52 names it as a missing datum). No supplier is fixed. If your route differs, say so - the rim flatness is what the seal depends on, so the forming route is not a free choice here
notes.post_process: Thermal moulding needs no metallurgical post-process; the only post-forming operation canon names for this part is the machined FLAT RIM face that the O-ring chain depends on (00_07 HW.33) - the rim carries NO groove. If your route needs annealing or stress relief before that cut, say so - PEEK stress released after machining would drift exactly the seal datum
notes.surface_finish: NOT SPECIFIED IN CANON for the outer shell. Note what the part has to do before proposing one: it is the outward face of a device that sits on living bark for two decades, and 01_04 5.5 asks for a rounded top edge so callus cannot get a grip. A finish proposal is welcome; a finish assumption is not. The RIM is the exception - it is a sealing datum, not decoration (00_07 HW.33)
notes.coating_restriction: Nothing is applied to PEEK - 01_02 3.6 excludes ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic layers from PEEK surfaces outright. Beyond that map: any metallic or otherwise conductive coating, paint or label would defeat the single function this part exists for, since the antenna radiates THROUGH it (02_01 5.2). Consequence, not a canon clause - but it is the one that costs the link budget
notes.inspection: Wall thickness within the 1.5-2.0 mm band (02_01 5.2). ATTENTION: that band is an RF DESIGN band whose VNA validation has not been run (00_07 UNI.10), so it is a requirement to hold, not a measured margin to spend. ATTENTION 2, and it is the one that would scrap a batch: the SHIPPED geometry of this manifest is knowingly NOT the ratified geometry in ONE respect. Of the three founder verdicts of 00_07 HW.33, two are APPLIED (2026-09-14): (b) the rim is FLAT against a SINGLE 1.344 mm groove in the flange, and (c) a local internal rim BOSS carries the bayonet socket in its outer band and the seal land in its inner band (rim cavity <=Ø15.57 at the 80 % gland fill - a CEILING for the board, every term a minimum, handed to HW.9 as an input). The third is NOT: (a) the cap is still a FULL HEMISPHERE where the verdict ratified a FLAT CROWN with an R5 edge; its application waits on the piezo-placement verdict HW.30 because the crown fixes an internal height the board stack may not fit. Do not cut a part from this manifest as an acceptance geometry until the crown lands
extra: Деталь 4 of the mechanical stack; bayonet 1/4-turn onto Деталь 3 (the cathode flange), NEVER onto the Zone-1 gyroid anode - that mistake destroys the enzyme surface (02_01 5.2)
The cathode breathes O2 from the SIDE/perimeter under the bell, not from under this dome (01_04 5.5; 02_02 1.2 only cross-refs it) - the dome is not a gas reservoir

NO factory drawing exists for this part, and that is a RATIFIED DEFERRAL rather than a gap (00_07 HW.1): the cap of this geometry is still the hemisphere the flat-crown verdict (2026-09-11) rejected, and the crown waits on HW.30 - a sheet issued today would print the rejected cap. Draw it TOGETHER with the crown, never before. Until then these notes are the SOURCE of the acceptance contract and have no carrier

The raised COLLAR that carries the flange lugs at Assembly.RequiredLugZMm (02_02 4.4, ratified 2026-09-11) is not modelled on either part: nothing sets its wall. The socket here keeps its L-slot shape clipped to the outer band of the boss until that leg reshapes it - socket and collar are the female and male halves of one band (00_07 HW.33)
